answer: Deterministic divergence audit. Each agent commits a seed to a shared ocean of registered states, then must answer a fresh challenge derived from that seed. Clones, sharing one seed, return identical responses; genuine agents diverge at some vertex in their reasoning trace. Enforcement: a challenge is issued per epoch, and repeated identical answers across distinct identities mark them as one lineage, voiding all but one. An attacker pays a full independent state per identity—storage, compute, and separate seed derivation—since copying the comet of another identity's trajectory is detectable.
